result.title: CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing efficiency in human T cells using novel guide RNA designs
result.authorString: Smith J, Jones A, Williams B, Chen C, Davis D
result.abstractText: We present a novel approach to CRISPR gene editing that significantly improves efficiency in human T cells. Our guide RNA design strategy achieves 95% editing efficiency while maintaining low off-target effects. This has implications for cell therapy and gene therapy applications.

result.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals heterogeneity in CRISPR-edited cell populations
result.authorString: Garcia M, Lee K, Patel R
result.abstractText: Using single-cell RNA sequencing, we characterized the transcriptomic landscape of CRISPR-edited cell populations. Our analysis reveals significant heterogeneity in editing outcomes and identifies molecular markers that predict editing success.

result.title: Computational modeling of protein folding dynamics in aqueous solutions
result.abstractText: We developed a new computational framework for modeling protein folding dynamics. Our approach combines molecular dynamics simulations with machine learning to predict folding pathways with high accuracy.
